integrity: The original stochastic gossip framework and moment method are attributed to prior authors; the asserted contribution is the exact parameter-wide rate-volatility phase diagram. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for the specified symmetric four-node partial-trust Poisson gossip chain. General graphs, asynchronous schemes with other normalizations, and empirical relevance are not established.
title: A finite mixing-rate maximum of opinion volatility in a four-agent gossip chain
